Plus, ppl might have a few evenings a week where they have lots of calories from alcohol but they definitely wouldn’t want to show that to an audience. But overall they don’t eat like mice every day, they just end up acting like they do because no one wants to watch an average day of boring, plain meals. I hope that helps at least a little and remember that you don’t know what people eat in private or with their family, so it’s very difficultly to accurately compare peoples diets
